# <span class="text-gray-900 dark:text-gray-100">Stages 801-1,000</span>

Attribute stone chance makes its last move in this stretch, capping at 1.725% around stage 827 and never rising again. After that, every per-stage dial except the raw numbers is frozen.

What is still growing, dramatically, is soul income: idle souls run from roughly seventy-eight thousand at stage 801 to over 1.7 million by stage 1,000. Soul weapon progression is effectively gated on how deep you can park, which makes the highest stage you can *safely* idle at far more valuable than the highest one you can barely clear.
